content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the NCERT Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download NCERT Senior Research Associate (SRA) Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Senior Research Associate (SRA): PG degree with 55% marks in Chemistry, Environment Science, Botany, Zoology, Life Sciences & other related discipline. Two years' experience in research/teaching/content development/curriculum development/training/programme implementation or any other relevant area.

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for NCERT Senior Research Associate (SRA) Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the post name for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The post name for this recruitment is Senior Research Associate (SRA) under the National Council of Educational Research and Training (NCERT).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Senior Research Associate (SRA) position in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the mode of application?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates are required to appear for an interview on the specified date with their documents.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in date?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 05 October 2026. Candidates must report during the designated registration hours.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the SRA post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Senior Research Associate (SRA) post is 45 years, with age relaxation provided as per Government of India norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for NET/Ph.D. qualified candidates?
faq.answer: Candidates possessing NET or Ph.D. qualifications are eligible for a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 42,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. What is the salary for Non-NET candidates?
faq.answer: Candidates who do not possess NET qualification are eligible for a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 40,000/-.

faq.question: Q8. What are the essential educational qualifications?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a PG degree with 55% marks in Chemistry, Environment Science, Botany, Zoology, Life Sciences, or other related disciplines, along with two years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry to the interview?
faq.answer: You should carry the duly filled application form, a recent photograph, valid ID proof, and original certificates along with self-attested photocopies of all educational and experience documents.

faq.question: Q10. Where will the interview be held?
faq.answer: The interview will be held in New Delhi, 110016. Please refer to the official notification for the exact building and room number details.
